note: DIU's CSE Class Routine V4.1 (effective 3 Oct 2026, the newest on DIU's notice board on 2026-10-19), parsed from its PDF; 1,961 class slots, every course token in the PDF accounted for, no room double-booked and no teacher in two rooms at once. CSE's own routine only: other departments book the same buildings (KT, G1, ANX1), so a free-room answer from this file alone overstates vacancy. A section is DIU's batch-section as printed ("68_D", lab groups "69_O1", retake sections "RE_A(3C)" with their credit tag); a mistyped name (a stray full stop, a missing bracket) is corrected with a note on the record. Consecutive slots of one section in one room are merged (a lab's two 90-minute slots become one meeting). Teachers are DIU's initials as printed; NT-n and EEE-1 / EEE_1 are placeholders the routine uses, kept as printed. Where two teachers share a section, faculty is null and the note names each. DIU publishes no section sizes or seats.
